high_findings.title: sanitizeTrackingValue .slice(0,255) can split a surrogate pair; ES2019 JSON.stringify emits a lone \udXXX escape and Rails json 2.6.1 raises JSON::ParserError, 400-ing the entire /magic_login or /sign_up POST
high_findings.verification: Orchestrator-reproduced both halves: ruby -rjson JSON.parse('{"a":"\ud83d"}') raises 'incomplete surrogate pair'; node: ('x'.repeat(254)+emoji).slice(0,255) ends in a lone high surrogate and JSON.stringify emits \ud83d
high_findings.impact: A signup URL carrying a >255-unit utm value whose 255/256 boundary splits an astral character breaks the signup POST entirely - user cannot sign up; input lost. Introduced by this feature (truncation is new code).
high_findings.recommendation: Surrogate-safe truncation: after slice(0,255), drop a trailing lone high surrogate. Add Jest regression test.
